sample_size.notes: Bear-market sample larger — typical for bearish reversal patterns.

target_calculation.description: Target = lowest trough (between tops) - (top - trough). Project downward from breakout below the lowest trough.

ultimate_low_method.definition: Lowest price after downward breakout before 20% reversal

failure_definition.description: Break-even failure: price fails to decline 5% below breakout (i.e., rises back above the lowest trough).

post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_note: Median ~51 days. Triple tops are FASTER than triple bottoms (51d vs 123d) — bearish reversals resolve quicker.

performance_statistics.best_market: bear (24% decline, 5% BE failure — strong bearish reversal)
performance_statistics.comparison_vs_triple_bottom: Faster (51d vs 123d), smaller avg move (22% vs 30%), but lower BE failure in bear market.

notes: PDF source: Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns (2nd ed.), chapter 51, p802-820, Table 51.2/51.3.
